title: The point blowup of a rational surface singularity is normal
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian normal Nagata local domain of dimension $2$ defining a rational singularity [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-per-rational-surface-singularity]. Then the ordinary blowup $\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathfrak m}(\operatorname{Spec}A)$ is normal [def-nagata-global-blowup], [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. No regularity or Gorenstein hypothesis on $A$ is imposed.

from.place: Technical surface-resolution input to dimension-normalized Verdier duality in lem-per-artin-gabber-affine-curve, proof Step 1; via the potential-dualizing construction and ILO XVII 3.4.1. Realizes the Tag 0BBV, resolve-lemma-rational-to-gorenstein, specialized using dualizing.tex Tag 0BFR (dualizing-lemma-ubiquity-dualizing), clauses (2),(5). Normal surfaces are Cohen-Macaulay by properties.tex Tag 0B3D, and an invertible dualizing sheaf gives Gorenstein local rings by duality.tex Tag 0AWW (duality-definition-gorenstein). input in the proof of Stacks 0BGN. Specific supporting input: 0BBV first paragraph: normalized point blowups of rational surface local rings are already ordinary blowups.
